preconditions.description: The number of vectors in S is at least 1 and at most 5 * 10^5.
The number of dimensions is at least 1 and at most 5 * 10^5.
Each vector in S has at most 2 coordinates equal to 1.
The coordinates of each vector are between 1 and m.

preconditions.expression: No two vectors in S are the same.
preconditions.description: All vectors in S are unique.

postconditions.description: The output consists of two integers: the size of T modulo 10^9+7 and the size of the smallest subset S' of S that can generate all vectors in T.
The second line of the output contains the indices of the elements of S' in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(v in T for v in S'[0:output_size_of_S_prime])
postconditions.description: All vectors in T can be generated by summing vectors from S' with at most 2 coordinates equal to 1.
